scripts.dev:backend: powershell -NoLogo -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$php = 'C:\xampp\php\php.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path $php)) { $php = 'php' }; if (-not (Get-Command $php -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Error 'PHP not found. Install XAMPP or add php to PATH.'; exit 1 }; & $php -S localhost:8000 -t ."
scripts.dev:all: powershell -NoLogo -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$php = 'C:\xampp\php\php.exe'; if (-not (Test-Path $php)) { $php = 'php' }; if (-not (Get-Command $php -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Error 'PHP not found. Install XAMPP or add php to PATH.'; exit 1 }; Start-Process http://localhost:8000; & $php -S localhost:8000 -t ."
